List Pages Organic Traffic

Executive Summary

The analysis reveals a clear stratification of value across our list page ecosystem. The Top Priority for migration are the high-volume, high-engagement 'Power Categories'—specifically /di/ (Activity + Destination) and /tdi/ (Activity + Destination + Time), which drive over 160k sessions with exceptional bounce rates (~10-16%). Route-specific pages (/fw/, /fr/) are also critical anchors for organic traffic.

Conversely, broad base categories like /d/ (Destination only) and /a/ (Activity only) show significantly lower volume and poorer engagement (bounce rates up to 45%). These should be Deprioritized or consolidated, as users clearly prefer more specific, intent-driven landing pages. The /rbs/ namespace also warrants caution due to its higher bounce rate (~38%).
